stemMd: Why does the passage mention keeping exits clear?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To show that every rule prevents adaptation

options.label: B
options.textMd: To replace visitor feedback with the initial layout

options.label: C

options.label: E
options.textMd: To show that useful flexibility still operates within constraints

explanationMd: Exit clearance is an example of a necessary boundary. The passage uses it to distinguish flexible use from complete absence of rules. Different arrangements remain possible within those practical limits.

distractorRationale.c: The revised policy retains multiple layouts.

distractorRationale.d: The text identifies no such universal danger.
distractorRationale.b: Feedback contributed to the revised policy.
